# VAJRA

> Vulnerability Analysis, Judgment, Repair & Assurance: Evidence-Driven Sovereign Cyber Reasoning System (CRS) & Neuro-Symbolic Autonomous Vulnerability Remediation Platform.

VAJRA connects the entire vulnerability-remediation lifecycle end-to-end: from multi-language Code Property Graph (CPG) discovery and causal risk prioritization to neural patch synthesis and 7-stage formal proof verification (including Z3 SMT constraint solving).

The central design principle: **The AI model is never the source of truth.** Specialized static analyzers produce concrete evidence, neural models propose minimal candidate diffs, and an independent formal verification matrix rigorously proves correctness and safety before any code is applied.

## Core Models & Subsystems

- [Model 1: Vulnerability Finder](https://aravkataria.github.io/VAJRA/benchmark/finder/): 116.5M parameter causal transformer trained on AST & Code Property Graph representations for zero-shot vulnerability discovery with 100% recall across OWASP Benchmark v1.2.
- [Model 2: Neural Patch Generator](https://aravkataria.github.io/VAJRA/benchmark/patchgenerator/): Targeted code repair generator producing syntax-validated diffs with 100% compilation success and AST invariant preservation across multi-language CWE suites.
- [Model 3: Formal AST/CPG Verifier](https://aravkataria.github.io/VAJRA/benchmark/verifier/): Interprocedural static analysis engine powered by Tree-sitter and Z3 SMT constraint solving to formally prove patch safety and eliminate false positives.

## Documentation & Web Resources

- [Home & Documentation](https://aravkataria.github.io/VAJRA/): Master documentation, architectural overview, component breakdown, and quickstart guide.
- [Master Benchmark Hub](https://aravkataria.github.io/VAJRA/benchmark/): Comprehensive empirical evaluation across 3,236 test cases (OWASP Benchmark v1.2 + wild framework codebases).
- [Interactive Web Workspace](https://aravkataria.github.io/VAJRA/app/): 100% serverless browser IDE for scanning repositories, visualizing vulnerability graphs, and applying verified patches.
- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/Aravkataria/VAJRA): Full source code, native Rust core engine, Python AI engines, Tauri desktop GUI, and test suites.

## Key Subsystems & Architecture

- [7-Stage Independent Verification Matrix](https://github.com/Aravkataria/VAJRA#6-the-7-stage-independent-verification-matrix): Syntactic validation, compilation check, anti-regression fuzzing, SMT formal constraint proving, blast radius containment, AST equivalence checking, and performance impact profiling.
- [Native Rust Core (ajra-core)](https://github.com/Aravkataria/VAJRA#3-native-rust-core-engine-vajra-core): High-throughput parallel scanner powered by Rayon for sub-millisecond AST and regex traversal.
- [Universal Code Property Graph (CPG)](https://github.com/Aravkataria/VAJRA#7-universal-multi-language-code-property-graph-cpg): Merges Abstract Syntax Trees (AST), Control Flow Graphs (CFG), and Program Dependence Graphs (PDG) across Python, Rust, JavaScript, TypeScript, Go, Java, C, and C++.
- [Risk Prioritization & Blast Radius Engine](https://github.com/Aravkataria/VAJRA#8-risk-prioritization--blast-radius-engine): Graph centrality and reachability algorithms assessing the transitive blast radius of vulnerabilities.
- [Patch Minimality & Complexity Evaluator](https://github.com/Aravkataria/VAJRA#9-patch-minimality--complexity-evaluator): Computes cyclomatic delta ($\Delta M$) and Levenshtein AST edit distance to ensure minimal syntactic disruption.
- [Long-Term Adaptive Learning](https://github.com/Aravkataria/VAJRA#11-long-term-adaptive-learning--outcome-tracking): Local repository knowledge graph (.vajra/knowledge_graph.json) recording verified patch outcomes and developer invariants.
